questions.stem: A 25-year-old primigravida is scheduled for a caesarean section. After discussing the risks, she chooses epidural anaesthesia. Which sign is not seen in correct placement of the epidural needle in the epidural space?

options.label: C
options.text: Aspiration of solution in the needle hub.
